summary: Implemented the Lambda transform feature in the MONAI repo, but did not run any tests (per instructions) and did not commit. Changes: (1) monai/transforms/utility/array.py: added Lambda(func), which raises TypeError on non-callable input and applies func to the input. (2) monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py: added Lambdad(keys, func), where func is one callable or a per-key sequence (validated via ensure_tuple_rep, which raises ValueError on length mismatch; non-callables raise TypeError), plus LambdaD/LambdaDict aliases; updated typing and utility imports. (3) docs/source/transforms.rst: added Lambda and Lambdad autodoc entries. (4) Added tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py covering the array call, named functions, shared and per-key functions, the alias, length mismatch, non-callable input, and no in-place mutation of the input dict. Caveat: Lambdad does not copy data, so in-place functions mutate the caller's arrays. Tests are unverified.
